A More Diverse Model World Erik Wilde: Openness Matters: Source and Interfaces in the Age of Agents

(8) Not Every Task Needs the Frontier

  • Open models now lag the frontier by about four months
  • Most (business) agent tasks never needed a frontier model
  • Running models locally changes cost and data exposure
  • Mixing and tweaking models becomes a real option


A More Diverse Model World Erik Wilde: Openness Matters: Source and Interfaces in the Age of Agents

(9) Many Models, One Interface

  • A portfolio of models replaces picking one winner
  • A gateway is the interface to the model layer
  • Models can be switched without touching applications
  • Controls and limits and monitoring end up in one place


A More Diverse Model World Erik Wilde: Openness Matters: Source and Interfaces in the Age of Agents

(10) AI Is an Implementation Detail

  • As little AI as possible and as much AI as necessary
  • AI is an implementation detail of a capability
  • Stable interfaces keep the capability separate from its implementation

Conclusions Erik Wilde: Openness Matters: Source and Interfaces in the Age of Agents

(13) Adopting AI Speed

  • A renewed focus on open interfaces and open data
  • An increasing focus on smaller and tweakable models
  • A new way of modularization (deterministic/probabilistic)
  • Analyzing and tweaking code becomes more achievable


Conclusions Erik Wilde: Openness Matters: Source and Interfaces in the Age of Agents

(14) Monday Tasks

  • Make AI consumption part of your API governance
  • Make SLMs and local models part of your strategy
